readings.Aries: Your capacity to begin is extraordinary. The question today is about depth, not speed. Go back to the original intention — it's still the right one.
readings.Taurus: Beauty is not frivolous to you — it's structural. Without it, you cannot function well. Something is about to become obvious.
readings.Gemini: You're very good at making things feel lighter. Someone around you needs weight acknowledged, not lifted. Saying less will move this further than saying more.
readings.Cancer: Something is asking to be mourned before it can be moved past. Let it. The first instinct was right.
readings.Leo: You want the room. You also sometimes want to be unknown. Both are real. The window for this is shorter than it looks.
readings.Virgo: Something you noticed and catalogued weeks ago is relevant now. Your records are good. This is a better week for listening than speaking.
readings.Libra: You've agreed to something that was wrong for you in the moment of agreeing. You can revisit it. This is a better week for listening than speaking.
readings.Scorpio: Something you suspected for months just became something you know. Now decide. Something small done consistently has more effect than something large done once.
readings.Sagittarius: The freedom you're seeking is available now, in this constraint. Find it. Simpler is correct here.
readings.Capricorn: Someone you respect is watching and taking notes. Good. You know what you're doing. The answer that feels too obvious is probably the actual answer.
readings.Aquarius: Your idealism is not naïveté. It is a choice. Keep choosing it, but with your eyes open. The question matters more than the answer right now.
readings.Pisces: Someone's pain has become your pain. This is your nature. Also: you are allowed to put it down. The week ahead rewards preparation you can still do today.

calculation_methods: Planetary longitudes: Jean Meeus 'Astronomical Algorithms' low-precision formulae (±1° accuracy)
Retrograde: computed from direction of longitude change vs previous day
Aspects: angular separation with standard orbs (conjunction 8°, sextile 6°, square/trine/opposition 8°, quincunx 3°)
Compatibility: element harmony base score + modality adjustment + date-seeded variance
Daily readings: deterministic date-seed (PRNG) selects from 60-entry per-sign pools + 30-entry suffix pool; 1,800 combinations per sign
